abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of Remote Sensors is allowed.

set_simulated_battery_mode.name: Set simulated battery mode
set_simulated_battery_mode.description: Sets the mode of the simulated battery. It charges or discharges until the mode is changed.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: charge raises the state of charge at 5 kW. discharge and maxuse lower it at 1.5 kW. sell lowers it at 5 kW. standby keeps it. pvcharge raises it with the power of the solar power sensor, at most 5 kW.
